hard_gates.name: calibration-before-confirmation
hard_gates.evidence: No executable two-phase reviewer state machine was present.

hard_gates.name: current-provider-bindings
hard_gates.evidence: Codex, Mistral, and DeepSeek identities plus provider routing, prices, limits, and the 24-hour freshness rule are hash-bound.

hard_gates.name: calibration-before-confirmation
hard_gates.evidence: The state machine cannot open confirmation until the same Codex task and both provider reviewers pass all frozen control gates.

hard_gates.name: fail-closed-execution-authority
hard_gates.evidence: The global freeze remains active, no bounded authorization exists, and execution commands re-check authorization and live metadata themselves.

hard_gates.name: bounded-cost-and-call-accounting
hard_gates.evidence: Simulation verifies 120 calls maximum, zero retries, per-call atomic accounting, USD 1.563034 conservative reservation, and USD 3 hard stop.

decision.rationale: The current reviewer identities and provider routes are frozen and the complete no-call state machine passes, so the next decision is the separately authorized calibration rather than another method redesign.
limitations: No reviewer has yet produced a real semantic judgment.
LLM-panel agreement is silver evidence and cannot be called independent human ground truth.
A fresh isolated Codex task is required because the design task has seen hidden controls.
The 24-hour metadata snapshot must be refreshed immediately before execution.
